subject.title: fix: prevent silent message loss from EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError

question: Should `settings.retry.provider.maxRetries` intentionally become the retry budget for complete lock-reacquiring reply/fallback cycles when an embedded prompt releases its session lock?
rationale: The branch removes a real race by prohibiting SDK-local retries in the released-lock window, but restoring the existing setting at a broader orchestration layer changes the observable retry and fallback contract for configured users.

options.title: Approve outer-cycle semantics
options.body: Accept full-cycle retries as the supported meaning of configured provider retries in embedded reply runs, with focused compatibility coverage for single- and multi-model routing.

options.title: Preserve narrower setting semantics
options.body: Require a design that keeps the configured setting scoped to provider attempts without allowing an SDK retry inside the released-lock window.

options.title: Split the change
options.body: Land only the steering and user-visible takeover handling, then design the configured-retry compatibility path separately.

recommendation.title: Approve outer-cycle semantics
recommendation.body: Accept full-cycle retries as the supported meaning of configured provider retries in embedded reply runs, with focused compatibility coverage for single- and multi-model routing.
